description: This file defines a utility enum 'LocationCurrentRequest' that manages current location retrieval, including caching, accuracy settings, and timeout handling, utilizing CoreLocation and async/await features.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current location, returning a cached value if fresh enough or performing a new location request with specified parameters and timeout.

methods.name: accuracyValue
methods.description: Converts an OpenClawLocationAccuracy enum to a corresponding CLLocationAccuracy value.
